label: Query Service REST API
type: the POST/GET /query/service endpoint through which statements and request parameters are submitted to the Query service
note: Folds api:query-rest-api, which batch B minted for the same thing while batch C was minting this id, in the same wave. Six files each, disjoint - a live instance of the standing limit that a written registry stops agents re-litigating the past but not each other in the present.
